stories.title: What Anthropic’s IPO Filing Reveals
stories.take: The reveal: $16.3B revenue in the first half (vs. $4.6B for all of 2025), a first profitable quarter in Q2 ($974M operating profit, 85% gross margins) and $132B in cash — against $417–431B in non-cancelable compute commitments, $600B+ signed • 11,900 customers spend $100k+ a year and net revenue retention is 900%, but 48% of revenue flows through partners like Google and AWS • The $80B first-half net loss is mostly a $72B paper accounting charge; founders keep 50.1% voting control via a new Class F stock • Bottom line: the S-1 changed little — it still comes down to future growth vs. very clear future obligations, 'bold but sane'

stories.title: Is Trump abandoning Ukraine?
stories.take: The answer: not outright abandonment, but a tilt toward Russia — sanctions lifted and Putin praised as a 'humanitarian,' while US weapons, intelligence and Starlink still flow to Ukraine • Ukraine's Starshield service was throttled for ~10 days in October, hampering air defenses, reportedly after White House pressure on Musk • A Melania-brokered ceasefire in Oleshky cut its population from 24,000 to ~2,000; Democrats vow to investigate the slowdown if they win Congress

stories.title: Why Nurses Are Quitting in Droves
stories.take: The answer: bedside RN turnover rose from 11% to 18% in 15 years despite ~$100k median pay — driven by chronic understaffing (ICU nurses handling 4–5 patients vs. a 1:2 recommended ratio), 30-hour patient waits, and rising workplace violence • Hospitals are responding with residency programs, higher wages, metal detectors and redesigned floors • Retention is now a top national priority, with turnover driving falls, infections and slower triage

stories.title: Lower those expectations
stories.take: Home sellers need to lower expectations: new-home sales fell 5%+ year over year, the median new-home price fell ~4%, and 1 in 5 sellers cut their asking price in September as mortgage rates topped 7% • A busy data week ahead: Fed decision Wednesday, then PCE inflation and the first Q3 GDP read Thursday; business investment is broadening beyond AI, with machinery orders up 16%+ • A new Global Capitalism Index ranks Switzerland No. 1 — the US has slipped, scoring lowest on property rights

stories.title: Boeing Cuts Delivery Target, Sending Shares to 18-Month Low
stories.take: Boeing shares fell 9.6% to a 52-week low, down 21% year to date, after the company cut its delivery forecast • The 737 rate is stuck at 47 a month, with 52 a month pushed to the second half of 2027 — CEO Kelly Ortberg: 'everything just got kind of pushed to the right for a year' • Wing, fuselage and engine supply problems, plus a sector-wide talent crunch also hitting Airbus, push pre-pandemic profitability further out

stories.title: Huge turnout in Israeli election
stories.take: Israeli turnout hit 44.9% early — the highest in over 40 years — in a vote framed as a referendum on Netanyahu's security record, with rival Eisenkot urging voters to oust the 'worst government' in Israel's history • In Sudan, a drone strike on a market in Nyala killed around 100 people; the war's toll tops 200,000 since 2022 • A limited ceasefire took effect in Russian-occupied Oleshky for aid, amid continued strikes across Ukraine

stories.title: Inside the early days of the AI revolution
stories.take: Kevin Roose's 'The AGI Chronicles': only ~50 people were involved at every key step of the AI race, and their rivalries shaped it — Musk and Page fell out after Page reportedly called Musk a 'speciesist' • Google had a ChatGPT-like chatbot, Meena, in 2020 — an internal memo warned 'Meena eats Google' — but never shipped it, fearing Search ad cannibalization • ChatGPT launched as an afterthought: staff bet on just 10,000–100,000 signups the night before • Roose revisits his viral Sydney encounter as the first public misalignment failure

stories.title: DF Direct Weekly #287: Xbox Helix $1200-$1800? BioWare Shut, FSR 4 RDNA 2 + Xbox, Sony Frame Gen!
stories.take: The answers: Fortune puts the Xbox Helix at $1,200–$1,800, with the home console now reported for 2028 (handheld 2027) and RAM/storage SKUs driving the price • EA has shut BioWare — the next Mass Effect is cancelled, with only ~50 people on the project • FSR 4.1 is live now for RDNA 2 / RX 6000 cards and coming to Xbox Series X|S, roughly matching FSR 3 Quality speed with much better image quality • A Sony patent points to extrapolation-based frame generation that could improve latency instead of adding it
